name: status_bar_scene_change
description: Hit a monster so its floating health bar appears, then walk to Field and back. No HealthLocalStatus bar may be left without an owner after a scene change.

steps.name: the hit shows a floating health bar
steps.note: if this fails the test cannot show the bug; the monster must be one that shows its bar when hit

steps.name: in Field: no health bar without an owner
back in Town: no health bar without an owner
